description: This file defines an abstract generic serializer for 32-bit enum types, along with specific implementations for DateTimeKind and DayOfWeek enums. It includes methods for serializing and deserializing enum values, managing type-specific details and memory handling.

classes.name: Enum32BaseCodec<T>
classes.description: Abstract generic serializer for enum types with a 32-bit underlying value, providing methods to write and read enum values.

classes.name: DateTimeKindCodec
classes.description: Serializer specifically for the DateTimeKind enum, inherits from Enum32BaseCodec.

classes.name: DayOfWeekCodec
classes.description: Serializer specifically for the DayOfWeek enum, inherits from Enum32BaseCodec.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the enum value into the writer buffer as a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a 32-bit integer from the reader buffer and converts it into the enum type.
